blocks.raw: Rewards catalog is a platform where brands can create rewards that the customers can purchase against their loyalty points. Rewards could be points, coupons, gift vouchers, cart promotions, or products from third-party vendors.
blocks.text: Rewards catalog is a platform where brands can create rewards that the customers can purchase against their loyalty points. Rewards could be points, coupons, gift vouchers, cart promotions, or products from third-party vendors.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Notes
>
> * Postman Collection for the APIs can be requested through Capillary Support during or after onboarding the org.
> * There is no limit on the number of rewards you can create.
> * New brands should no longer use the **"intouch points"** field. Instead, they should only use the new **"payment config"** block.
